name: 基本給 (basic salary)
authority: 労働基準法 art.24: wages paid in full, in cash, directly, at least monthly on a fixed day. A part month is paid for the calendar days employed (the work rules' own proration method governs; art.89(ii)).

name: 時間外労働 割増賃金 (overtime, first 60 hours)
authority: 労働基準法 art.37(1) with 割増賃金令: overtime beyond the statutory hours (art.32: 40 a week, 8 a day) at 125% of the hourly wage; 労働基準法施行規則 art.19(1)(iv): a monthly wage over the monthly average scheduled hours (company.facts.monthly_average_scheduled_hours). Every fixed allowance of the contract is in the base (terms.monthly_wage), which over-states it where family, commuting, housing or other art.37(5)/施行規則 art.21 allowances exist — never below the law. The hourly premium wage is rounded to the yen (昭和63年3月14日 基発第150号). Managers and supervisors (art.41(ii)) and officers are outside it. work.overtime_hours is the approved statutory overtime of the month. Overtime on the statutory rest day is paid by REST_DAY_WORK instead and does not count toward the 60 hours.

name: 時間外労働 割増賃金 (overtime beyond 60 hours a month)
authority: 労働基準法 art.37(1) proviso: overtime beyond 60 hours in a month at 150%; the small-enterprise deferral (附則 art.138) ended on 1 April 2023 (働き方改革関連法, Law 71 of 2018). Same hourly base as OVERTIME. The substitute paid leave of art.37(3) is not modelled.

name: 法定休日労働 割増賃金 (statutory rest-day work)
authority: 労働基準法 arts.35 and 37(1) with 割増賃金令: work on the statutory weekly rest day at 135% of the hourly wage for every hour worked (work.days with day_type REST — the shift definitions mark the 法定休日; a non-statutory day off is OFF and its hours are ordinary overtime). Same hourly base as OVERTIME; managers and supervisors (art.41(ii)) and officers are outside it.

name: 深夜労働 割増賃金 (late-night work premium)
authority: 労働基準法 art.37(4): work between 22:00 and 05:00 (rules.night_work) earns a further 25% of the hourly wage, on top of any overtime or rest-day premium (施行規則 art.20); it applies to managers and supervisors too (art.41 excludes only hours, breaks and rest days; 最高裁 平成21年12月18日). Hours are the worked intervals inside the window (hours_between). Officers are not workers.

name: 欠勤控除 (unpaid absence)
authority: 労働基準法 art.24 and the no-work-no-pay principle (民法 art.624(1)): unpaid leave and absence days are not paid. The divisor is the calendar days of the month; the work rules may set another (art.89(ii)).

name: 最低賃金差額 (minimum wage top-up)
authority: 最低賃金法 arts.4(1)–(2), 9 and 10: a wage below the regional minimum of the workplace's prefecture is void to that extent and replaced by the minimum (rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region]: the hourly amount in force on the last day of the period); 最低賃金法施行規則 art.2: a monthly wage is compared per hour over the monthly average scheduled hours. The base salary alone is compared, so a qualifying fixed allowance never reduces the top-up (overtime, bonuses, family and commuting allowances are excluded by 施行規則 art.1). Officers are not workers. A specified (industry) minimum wage of the establishment's industry (最低賃金法 arts.15–16) governs where higher (art.6(1)); customer input: company.facts.industry_minimum_wage_hourly.
